howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能解释 Codex Rules 的自动注入行为：启用后会在会话开始和提交消息时注入静态项目说明，在代码修改后注入匹配规则；也会说明支持的规则文件位置和环境变量配置。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 行为、项目规则、规则文件位置等问题时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件位置？
say.note: Claude 会列出所有支持的来源。
Claude 会给出环境变量设置方法。
Claude 会解释各模式含义。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude can explain Codex Rules' automatic injection behavior, supported rule file locations, and environment configuration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, or rule file locations, among other related topics.

say_en.text: What rule file locations does Codex Rules support?
say_en.note: Claude will list all supported sources.

say_en.text: How do I disable Codex Rules?
say_en.note: Claude will explain how to set the environment variable.
Claude will explain what each mode means.
